article.story: STATESBORO, Ga. -- — Quintero Barnett's 27 points helped Middle Tennessee defeat Georgia Southern 85-78 on Tuesday. Barnett also added three steals for the Blue Raiders (4-1). Jahvin Carter scored 19 points and added six rebounds and eight assists. Marcus Whitlock shot 6 for 9, including 6 for 7 from beyond the arc to finish with 18 points. Whitlock scored 15 points in the second half. Dallas Gardner led the way for the Eagles (1-4) with 18 points. Georgia Southern also got 16 points, nine rebounds and three steals from Eltramon Smith Jr. Elidjah Savane also had 11 points, eight rebounds and three blocks. Up next Middle Tennessee's next game is Friday against Temple, and Georgia Southern visits Houston Christian on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
